恶意软件分类模型的概念漂移检测和自适应再训练Concept Drift Detection and Adaptive Retraining of Malware Classification Models

Christofer Washington Berruz Chungata11 1 Department of Computer Science, San Jose State University Martin Jureček22 2 Faculty of Information Technology, Czech Technical University in Prague Affiliation: Katerina Potika11footnotemark: 1 William B. Andreopoulos11footnotemark: 1 Mark Stamp11footnotemark: 1   33 3 mark.stamp@@sjsu.edu
摘要Abstract

概念漂移是指随着时间的推移而发生的变化 数据的统计特性，与数据相比 用于训练学习模型。 用于恶意软件检测或分类的机器学习模型 特别容易受到性能影响 概念漂移引起的退化，如 攻击者不断修改现有的恶意软件。 在本章中，我们分析了两种基于机器学习的 自动化的方法 概念漂移检测——一种基于 一类支持向量机 (OCSVM) 以及之前研究过的技术 基于小批量Concept drift refers to changes over time in the statistical properties of data, as compared to the data that was used to train a learning model. Machine learning models for malware detection or classification are particularly susceptible to performance degradation caused by concept drift, as attackers constantly modify existing malware. In this chapter, we analyze two machine learning-based approaches to automated concept drift detection—a novel approach based on One-Class Support Vector Machines (OCSVM) and a previously-studied technique based on MinibatchKK-均值（MK-均值）。对于 比较我们也考虑 最大平均差异（MMD）， 用于检测多维数据变化的统计技术。 我们进行了一系列广泛的实验 四种学习效果比较 模型，即多层感知器（MLP）， 随机森林 (RF)、支持向量机 (SVM)、 和极限梯度提升（XGB）。 对于每个模型，我们考虑三种不同的场景： 不发生模型重新训练的静态场景， 模型不断变化的周期性场景 无论概念漂移如何，都进行重新训练， 以及一个漂移感知场景 仅当检测到概念漂移时才重新训练模型。 在漂移感知场景下， 我们分析准确性和训练效率之间的权衡 使用帕累托前沿分析。 我们发现所有三种概念漂移检测技术 达到与 定期再培训，同时在方面提供显着更高的效率 必须重新训练的模型数量。 此外，基于漂移感知的再训练 我们的 OCSVM 技术总体上优于 MK-Means 和 MMD 方法。 总的来说，这些结果提供了强有力的证据，表明我们能够准确地 检测恶意软件分类模型中的概念漂移。 此外，我们的概念漂移检测技术 高效实用，更新过程 学习模型可以轻松实现完全自动化。-Means (MK-Means). For comparison we also consider Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), a statistical technique for detecting changes in multidimensional data. We conduct an extensive series of experiments comparing the effectiveness of four learning models, namely, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB). For each of these models, we consider three distinct scenarios: A static scenario where no model retraining occurs, a periodic scenario where models are constantly retrained irrespective of concept drift, and a drift-aware scenario where models are only retrained when concept drift is detected. Under the drift-aware scenario, we analyze the tradeoff between accuracy and training efficiency using Pareto Front analysis. We find that all three concept drift detection techniques achieve classification accuracy comparable to periodic retraining, while offering substantially greater efficiency in terms of the number of models that must be retrained. In addition, drift-aware retraining based on our OCSVM technique generally outperforms the MK-Means and MMD approaches. Overall, these results provide strong evidence that we are able to accurately detect concept drift in malware classification models. Furthermore, our concept drift detection techniques are efficient and practical, and the process of updating learning models can easily be fully automated.

1 简介Introduction

学习模型所依据的数据的统计属性随时间的变化 接受过训练的称为概念漂移。 鉴于机器学习模型从数据中学习，概念漂移可以 降低此类模型在推理过程中的性能。Change over time in the statistical properties of data on which learning models have been trained is known as concept drift. Given that machine learning models learn from data, concept drift can degrade the performance of such models during inference.

由于恶意软件不断发展，概念漂移是恶意软件检测中一个特别重要的问题。 根据Concept drift is a particularly important problem in malware detection as malware is constantly evolving. According to[3, 50]，攻击者修改恶意软件有两个目的——添加 或修改功能并逃避检测。因此，开发人员和研究人员使用 用于恶意软件检测或分类的机器学习模型必须考虑概念漂移 在现实系统中部署这些模型时。, attackers modify malware for two purposes—to add or modify functionality and to evade detection. As a result, developers and researchers using machine learning models for malware detection or classification must take concept drift into consideration when deploying these models in real-world systems.

由恶意软件引起的网络攻击数量，例如勒索软件攻击， 近年来显着增加The number of cyberattacks due to malware, such as ransomware attacks, has increased significantly in recent years[6]。 被错误分类为良性的单个恶意软件样本可能会造成严重后果 通过瘫痪机器或扣押数据以勒索赎金，从而对系统造成严重破坏。. A single malware sample that is incorrectly classified as benign can wreak havoc on a system by bringing down machines or holding data hostage for ransom.

减轻概念漂移影响的一种解决方案是不断重新训练模型 用于检测。然而，这种方法的资源需求可能是 在计算资源和能源使用方面非常重要。 在一个重要的研究工作集中于最大限度地减少资源消耗的时代 复杂的机器学习模型，例如深度神经网络（DNN）和 大语言模型（LLM）One solution to mitigate the effects of concept drift is to constantly retrain the models used for detection. However, the resource demands of this approach may be substantial, in terms of computational resources and energy usage. In an era where significant research efforts focus on minimizing the resource consumption of complex machine learning models, such as Deep Neural Networks (DNN) and Large-Language Models (LLM)[15, 34]，不断的再训练 似乎是一种倒退。, constant retraining would seem to be a step backwards.

在这项研究中，我们进行了涉及两种基于机器学习的实验 恶意软件分类模型中概念漂移检测的方法——基于 小批量In this research, we conduct experiments involving two machine learning-based approaches for concept drift detection in malware classification models—one based on MinibatchKK- 均值 (MK-Means) 和另一个 基于一类支持向量机 (OCSVM)。为了比较，我们还考虑 使用众所周知的统计技术进行概念漂移检测 最大平均差异（MMD）， 可用于检测多维数据的变化。 为了证明这些概念漂移检测方法的有效性， 我们考虑以下三种情况，并进行讨论 更详细的信息请参见章节-Means (MK-Means) and another based on One-Class Support Vector Machines (OCSVM). For comparison, we also consider concept drift detection using the well-known statistical technique of Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), which can be applied to detect changes in multidimensional data. To demonstrate the effectiveness of these concept drift detection approaches, we consider the following three scenarios, which are discussed in more detail in Section3.2.

  1. 1.

    在训练数据的初始时间段上训练分类模型， 并且不会发生再培训。这代表了不考虑概念漂移的场景。 我们将此称为A classification model is trained on the initial temporal segment of the training data, and no retraining occurs. This represents a scenario where concept drift is not considered. We refer to this as the静态的static场景。scenario.

  2. 2.

    如 i) 中所示，分类模型是在训练数据的初始时间段上进行训练的。 然后定期对模型进行重新训练。这代表了一个场景，其中 考虑了概念漂移，但没有努力最小化概念漂移的数量 必须重新训练的模型。我们将此称为As in i), a classification model is trained on the initial temporal segment of the training data. Then the model is retrained at regular periodic intervals. This represents a scenario where concept drift is considered, but no effort is made to minimize the number of models that must be retrained. We refer to this as the定期再培训periodic retraining场景。scenario.

  3. 3.

    如 ii) 所示，分类模型在训练数据的初始时间段上进行训练 并考虑概念漂移。然而，我们不是定期重新训练，而是只在以下情况下重新训练： 概念漂移是通过上述方法之一检测的。这代表了一个场景 我们考虑了概念漂移，但我们也尝试最小化模型再训练。 我们将此称为As in ii), a classification model is trained on the initial temporal segment of the training data and concept drift is considered. However, instead of periodic retraining, we only retrain when concept drift is detected via one of the methods mentioned above. This represents a scenario where we account for concept drift, but we also attempt to minimize model retraining. We refer to this as the漂移意识再训练drift-aware retraining场景。scenario.

对于这三种场景中的每一种，我们考虑四种分类模型，即 多层感知器 (MLP)、随机森林 (RF)、极限梯度提升 (XGB)、 和支持向量机（SVM）。此外，对于每个模型场景 组合，我们考虑了 20 种不同的恶意软件家族组合。 因此，我们进行了 80 次静态实验、80 次定期再训练实验， 和 240 个漂移感知再训练实验（80 个使用 OCSVM、 MK-Means 和 MMD 漂移检测器），为我们提供了总共 400 个不同的实验。For each of these three scenarios, we consider four classification models, namely, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Random Forest (RF), eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Furthermore, for each of these model-scenario combinations, we consider 20 distinct combinations of malware families. Thus, we conduct 80 static experiments, 80 periodic retraining experiments, and 240 drift-aware retraining experiments (80 using each of the OCSVM, MK-Means, and MMD drift detectors), giving us a total of 400 distinct experiments.

2 背景Background

在本节中，我们首先讨论概念漂移和恶意软件检测。 然后我们提供有关 OCSVM、MK-Means 和 MMD 技术的详细信息， 这构成了我们自动化概念漂移检测实验的基础。 最后，我们简要介绍了我们实验中使用的学习模型。In this section, we first discuss concept drift and malware detection. Then we provide details on the OCSVM, MK-Means, and MMD techniques, which form the basis for our automated concept drift detection experiments. Finally, we briefly introduce the learning models that are used in our experiments.

2.1 概念漂移Concept Drift

概念漂移被定义为数据统计属性随时间的变化， 这会影响机器学习模型的性能Concept drift is defined as changes in the statistical properties of data over time, which can affect the performance of machine learning models[5]。 现实世界系统中部署的机器学习模型可能会受到概念漂移的不利影响， 由于用于训练模型的数据可能会过时或变得无关紧要。 基于机器学习的恶意软件检测系统当然就是这种情况， 因为恶意软件家族通常会随着时间的推移而演变。. Machine learning models deployed in real-world systems may be adversely affected by concept drift, as the data used for training the model can age out or become irrelevant. This is certainly the case for machine learning-based malware detection systems, as malware families generally tend to evolve over time.

概念漂移可能突然发生、逐渐发生，也可能反复发生Concept drift can occur abruptly, gradually, or it can be recurring[5]。 突然的概念漂移是最容易检测到的，而渐进和反复出现的概念漂移则需要 更复杂的方法，结合了数据和模型的先前知识. Abrupt concept drift is the easiest to detect, while gradual and recurring concept drift require more sophisticated methods that incorporate previous knowledge of the data and the model[11, 43, 49, 59].

根据According to[5]、任何概念漂移检测技术 可以分为四类之一，即基于数据分布的， 基于性能的、混合的和基于上下文的。 基于性能的方法被认为比基于数据分布的方法更可靠， 因为他们关注模型表现不佳的实例, any concept drift detection technique can be classified into one of four categories, namely, data distribution-based, performance-based, hybrid, and context-based. Performance-based methods are considered more reliable than data distribution-based methods, as they focus on instances where the model is performing poorly[5]。 然而，此类方法依赖于测量明确定义的性能指标的能力 （例如，准确度、精确度、召回率、F1 分数），以及使用机器学习模型来 对恶意软件进行分类，但通常缺乏此类信息。. However, such methods rely on the ability to measure well-defined performance metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score), and when using machine learning models to classify malware, such information is generally lacking.

考虑到恶意软件领域中基于性能的方法的局限性， 我们将注意力集中在基于数据分布的方法上。也就是说我们需要漂移检测 可以通过直接分析数据来执行的技术，而不依赖于 模型性能的度量。我们验证我们的漂移检测方法是否成功 通过比较三种不同分类模型的性能 场景——这些场景的详细信息在章节中给出Given the limitations of performance-based methods in the malware domain, we focus our attention on data distribution-based methods. That is, we require drift detection techniques that can be performed by directly analyzing the data, without relying on measures of model performance. We validate that our drift detection approaches succeed by comparing the performance of classification models under three distinct scenarios—details on these scenarios are given in Section3.2.

2.2 恶意软件检测Malware Detection

恶意软件检测是识别给定软件是否是恶意软件的过程 恶意（恶意软件）或良性。恶意软件检测是一个极其重要的研究领域 至少出于三个原因。首先，漏报（恶意软件被错误分类为良性）可能会导致 对系统造成重大损害，例如数据丢失和系统停机。 其次，误报（良性错误分类为恶意软件）可能会导致严重的后果。 给用户带来不便。即使相对较小的误报率也可能导致 “狼来了的男孩”综合症，用户对系统失去信任并忽视 警告。第三，恶意软件不断发展，使得检测新的恶意软件变得具有挑战性。 恶意软件变体Malware detection is the process of identifying whether a given piece of software is malicious (malware) or benign. Malware detection is a vitally important area of research for at least three reasons. First, false negatives (malware misclassified as benign) can lead to significant damage to a system, such as data loss and system downtime. Second, false positives (benign misclassified as malware) can lead to significant inconvenience to users. Even a relatively small false positive rate can result in a “boy who cried wolf” syndrome, where users lose trust in the system and ignore warnings. Third, malware is constantly evolving, making it challenging to detect new malware variants[3, 50].

在过去的 20 年里，恶意软件研究发生了巨大的转变，如今的重点是 以机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）技术为主。 来自经典的 ML 模型，例如支持向量机 (SVM) 和 随机森林 (RF) 到深度学习模型，例如卷积神经网络 (CNN) 和循环神经网络（RNN），学习模型现在通常应用于 恶意软件检测和分类问题Over the past 20 years, malware research has shifted dramatically, to where the focus today is dominated by machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques. From classical ML models, such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Random Forests (RF), to DL models, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), learning models are now routinely applied to the malware detection and classification problems[4, 35, 42].

近年来，概念漂移对恶意软件检测的影响引起了一些关注 来自研究人员的关注——尽管关注程度当然不如其重要性 的主题保证。例如，作者In recent years, the impact of concept drift on malware detection has gained some attention from researchers—although certainly not as much attention as the importance of the topic warrants. For example, the authors of[31]提出了一种通过学习来检测和分类恶意软件中概念漂移的新技术 控制流图中据称具有漂移不变的特征。此类研究的另一个例子 可以在proposed a novel technique for detecting and classifying concept drift in malware by learning supposedly drift-invariant features from control flow graphs. Another example of such research can be found in[1]，其中引入了 MORPH， 用于恶意软件检测的神经网络的基于伪标签的概念漂移适应方法。 此外，该论文, which introduced MORPH, a pseudo-label-based concept drift adaptation method for neural networks as used for malware detection. Additionally, the paper[25]考虑梦想， 一种半监督系统，可增强基于深度学习的恶意软件中的偏差检测 分类器。请注意，我们研究中考虑的方法 不同于considers DREAM, a semi-supervised system that enhances drift detection in deep learning-based malware classifiers. Note that the approaches considered in our research differ from[1, 25, 31]，当我们使用无监督机器学习技术时 实施起来更快、更简单、更高效。 我们的方法论建立在并扩展了以下工作的基础上：, as we use unsupervised machine learning techniques that are faster, simpler, and more efficient to implement. Our methodology builds on and extends the work in[36].

我们顺便指出，对恶意软件进化的研究与概念漂移有关， 从某种意义上说，此类研究涉及恶意软件随时间的变化。 然而，在概念漂移研究中，重点是这些变化如何影响 机器学习模型的性能，而恶意软件进化研究 处理变化本身。隐马尔可夫模型 (HMM)We note in passing that research into malware evolution is related to concept drift, in the sense that such research deals with changes to malware over time. However, in concept drift research, the focus is on how these changes affect the performance of machine learning models, while malware evolution research deals with the changes themselves. Hidden Markov Models (HMM)[53], 词向量, Word2Vec[39], 支持向量机, SVMs[55], 和层次树模型, and hierarchical tree models[60]都已经习惯了 研究恶意软件的演变。have all been used to study malware evolution.

对恶意软件概念漂移检测的研究需要包含以下内容的数据： 不仅在很长一段时间内存在大量恶意软件样本， 但还包括可靠的时间戳。这是具有挑战性的，因为当 最初创建的恶意软件样本并不普遍可用。因此，修改 或收集日期用作创建日期的代理。在 KronoDroid 之前 数据集Research into concept drift detection for malware requires data that contains not only a significant number of malware samples over an extended period of time, but also include reliable timestamps. This is challenging because the time when a malware sample was originally created is not generally available. Therefore, modification or collection dates are used as proxies for the creation date. Prior to the KronoDroid dataset[22]，用于研究的其他恶意软件数据集涉及 恶意软件分析的时间方面包括 Malicia 数据集, other malware datasets used for research involving temporal aspects of malware analysis included the Malicia dataset[37]以及恶意软件集合and the malware collection in[28].

2.3 概念漂移检测技术Concept Drift Detection Techniques

在本节中，我们将介绍我们采用的两种无监督学习技术 用于概念漂移检测，即MinibatchIn this section, we introduce the two unsupervised learning techniques that we employ for concept drift detection, namely, MinibatchKK-均值（MK-均值） 和一类支持向量机 (OCSVM)。 此外，我们引入了最大平均差异（MMD），这是一种成熟的技术 检测多维数据中的数据漂移。有关我们如何使用这些的更多详细信息 概念漂移检测技术在章节中提供-Means (MK-Means) and One-Class Support Vector Machines (OCSVM). Furthermore, we introduce Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), an established technique to detect data drift in multidimensional data. Additional details on precisely how we employ these techniques for concept drift detection are provided in Section3.2.

对于概念漂移检测，我们使用 MK-Means 来聚类连续（重叠） 成对的时间批次样本，我们计算平均轮廓系数 对于每个这样的聚类。如果平均轮廓系数的变化从一对 下一个批次超过指定阈值，这意味着代表的特征 底层样本发生了变化，因此发生了概念漂移。 有关用于概念漂移检测的 MK-Means 的更多详细信息，请参阅第 1 节For concept drift detection, we use MK-Means to cluster consecutive (overlapping) pairs of temporal batches of samples, and we compute the average silhouette coefficient for each such clustering. If the change in average silhouette coefficient from one pair of batches to the next exceeds a specified threshold, this implies that the features representing the underlying samples have changed, and hence concept drift has occurred. More details on MK-Means for concept drift detection are provided in Section3.2.2。 我们注意到，我们使用 MK-Means 在恶意软件中进行概念漂移检测，严格遵循 接近于. We note that our use of MK-Means for concept drift detection in malware closely follows the approach in[36].

2.3.2 一类支持向量机One-Class Support Vector Machines

支持向量机 (SVM) 是用于分类的监督机器学习模型 和回归任务。一类 SVM (OCSVM) 是 SVM 的一种变体，在 无监督模式，因此不需要标记数据。 OCSVM 最初是 引入于Support Vector Machines (SVM) are supervised machine learning models used for classification and regression tasks. One-Class SVMs (OCSVM) are a variant of SVMs that are trained in an unsupervised mode, and hence labeled data is not required. OCSVMs were originally introduced in[45].

OCSVM 广泛用于异常值检测OCSVMs are used widely for outlier detection[16, 33]。 异常值检测是一个普遍问题，对于给定的数据集，存在两个区域 定义为异常值和异常值。异常值与内部值显着不同， 而内点则构成了大部分数据。 存在许多用于异常值检测的技术，包括鲁棒协方差. Outlier detection is a generic problem where, for a given dataset, there exists two regions defined as inliers and outliers. The outliers differ significantly from the inliers, while the inliers form the bulk of the data. Many techniques exist for outlier detection, including Robust Covariance[44], 隔离森林, Isolation Forest[32]和局部异常值因子, and Local Outlier Factor[9]; 参考; refer to[46]对这些结果进行直观比较 合成数据集上的技术。for a visual comparison of the results of these techniques on a synthetic dataset.

OCSVM 尝试找到训练样本代表的区域 数据的主导分布。 OCSVM 包含正则化参数OCSVM tries to find the region where the training samples are representative of the dominant distribution of the data. OCSVMs include a regularization parameterν∈(0,1)\nu\in(0,1), 它设置了可被视为异常值的训练数据点比例的上限。 较大的值, which sets an upper limit on the fraction of training data points that can be considered outliers. Larger values ofν\nu可以导致更复杂但更宽松的决策边界， 而较小的值can lead to a more complex, but looser, decision boundary, while smaller values ofν\nu产生一个更简单但更严格的决策边界。 对于具有大量异常值的数据集，yield a simpler, but tighter, decision boundary. For a dataset with a high number of outliers, too small of values ofν\nu可以结果 在较长的训练时间和对噪声过于敏感的模型中。can result in long training times and models that are overly sensitive to noise.

对于给定的 OCSVM 模型，令For a given OCSVM model, letnoutliersn_{\out}是异常值的数量并且be the number of outliers andninliersn_{\inli}内点的数量。我们定义the number of inliers. We define

r=noutliersninliersr=\frac{n_{\out}}{n_{\inli}} (1)

如果这个比例If this ratiorr随着时间的推移而变化，可以合理地假设基础 数据的分布发生了变化。因此，我们可以使用OCSVM来检测概念 通过监控异常值数量与正常值数量的比率来进行漂移。 有关我们如何使用 OCSVM 进行概念漂移检测的更多详细信息，请参阅 节中给出changes over time, it is reasonable to assume that the underlying distribution of the data has changed. Therefore, we can use OCSVM to detect concept drift by monitoring the ratio of the number of outliers to the number of inliers. Additional details on how we employ OCSVM for concept drift detection are given in Section3.2.2。 据作者所知，这是 OCSVM 首次用于 概念漂移检测，尽管 OCSVM 以前曾用于 恶意软件异常检测. 2.4 学习模型Learning Models

在本节中，我们介绍实验中考虑的四种学习模型。 这些是标准学习模型，用于测试我们的概念漂移检测技术。In this section, we introduce the four learning models that are consider in our experiments. These are standard learning models that serve to test our concept drift detection techniques.

2.4.1 多层感知器Multilayer Perceptron

多层感知器 (MLP) 是一种经典类型的前馈人工神经网络 (ANN)。 MLP 由输入层、输出层和一个或多个隐藏层组成。 每个隐藏层都与上面和下面的层完全连接。 MLP 通常使用反向传播进行训练。 训练 MLP 是分批次和历元完成的——一个历元代表一个前向和 向后传递整个训练集，通常分为小批量。A MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP) is a classic type of feedforward Artificial Neural Network (ANN). An MLP consists of an input layer, an output layer, and one or more hidden layers. Each hidden layer is fully connected to the layers above and below. MLPs are usually trained using backpropagation. Training MLPs is done in batches and epochs—one epoch represents a forward and backward pass through the entire training set, which is usually divided into minibatches.

MLP 架构的主要超参数是隐藏层的数量， 每层神经元的数量以及激活函数的选择。 对于分类任务，交叉熵被广泛使用，它可用于The main hyperparameters of an MLP architecture are the number of hidden layers, the number of neurons in each layer, and the choice of activation functions. For classification tasks, cross-entropy is widely used, and it is available inscikit学习scikit-learn [48]。 对于二元分类，二元交叉熵（BCE），也称为对数损失， 被使用. For binary classification, Binary Cross Entropy (BCE), also known as Log Loss, is used[51]。假设分类器是一个概率模型， BCE 测量两个伯努利分布之间的距离——真实分布 分布和预测分布由 分类器. Assuming a classifier is a probabilistic model, BCE measures the distance between two Bernoulli distributions—the true distribution and the predicted distribution given by the classifier[51]。 因此，对于. Thus, fornn样品，将samples, theBCE\BCE计算为is computed as

BCE=−1n∑i=1n(yilog(pi)+(1−yi)log(1−pi))\BCE=-\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\big(y_{i}\log(p_{i})+(1-y_{i})\log(1-p_{i})\big)

哪里whereyiy_{i}是样本的实际标签（0 或 1）is the actual label (0 or 1) of sampleii, 和, andpip_{i}是 的预测概率is the predicted probability of theithi^{\thth}样本属于第 1 类。 请注意，由于sample being in class 1. Note that due to thelog\log术语中，BCE 对更有信心的人给予更高的惩罚， 但不正确的预测。term, BCE assigns a higher penalty to more confident, but incorrect, predictions.

2.4.2 支持向量机Support Vector Machine

支持向量机 (SVM) 是一种监督机器学习模型。 SVM 的目标是找到将数据分类的最佳超平面。A Support Vector Machine (SVM) is a supervised machine learning model. The goal of an SVM is to find the optimal hyperplane that separates the data into classes.

为了实现可分离性，SVM 可以使用以下方法将数据映射到更高维的空间： 核函数。选择核函数使得计算 高维空间中的点积不会产生任何显着的影响 输入数据的计算成本——这被称为“内核技巧”。 最流行的核函数是线性核函数、多项式核函数、 和径向基函数（rbf）To achieve separability, SVMs can map the data into a higher dimensional space using a kernel function. The kernel function is selected such that computing the dot product in a higher dimensional space does not incur any significant computational cost in terms of the input data—this is known as the “kernel trick.” The most popular kernel functions are linear, polynomial, and radial basis function (rbf)[57]。 有关 SVM 的更多详细信息，请参见，例如. For additional details on SVMs, see, for example[14].

2.4.3 随机森林Random Forest

随机森林（RF）是一种集成机器学习技术，结合了 决策树进行预测。随机森林使用“套袋” 创建不相关的决策树Random Forest (RF) is an ensemble machine learning technique that combines decision trees to make a prediction. Random Forest uses “bagging” to create uncorrelated decision trees[26]。 随机森林是一种经典的机器学习模型，在实践中通常可以与 更复杂的神经网络模型。. Random Forest is a classical machine learning model that in practice can often rival more complex neural network models.

RF 的一个重要超参数是树木的深度。 更深的深度意味着每棵树中包含更多的决策， 这可能会导致更高的准确性，但代价是更长的训练时间， 以及过度拟合的可能性增加。 RF 模型具有良好的泛化能力 考虑到组件决策树的不相关性质。 有关 RF 的更多详细信息，请参阅An important hyperparameter of RF is the depth of the trees. A deeper depth means that more decisions are included in each tree, which can possibly lead to a higher accuracy, at the cost of a higher training time, as well as an increased chance of overfitting. RF models tend to generalize well given the uncorrelated nature of the component decision trees. For more details on RFs, refer to[8].

2.4.4 极端梯度提升Extreme Gradient Boosting

与 RF 类似，eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB) 是一种集成机器学习 基于决策树的技术。值得注意的是，XGBoost 是一个优化的 通用梯度增强算法的版本，目标是最大化性能 和效率Similar to RF, eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB) is an ensemble machine learning technique based on decision trees. It is important to note that XGBoost is an optimized version of a general gradient boosting algorithm, with the goal of maximizing performance and efficiency[10].

XGBoost 使用 boosting 而不是 bagging，这与 RF 不同。 在实践中，这意味着虽然 RF 通过以下方式构建独立的决策树： 对特征和样本进行随机装袋，XGBoost 依次构建决策树。 在 XGBoost 中，每个新的（可能是弱的）分类器旨在预测 先前的分类器XGBoost uses boosting instead of bagging, which distinguishes it from RF. In practice, this means that while RF builds independent decision trees by random bagging of the features and samples, XGBoost builds decision trees sequentially. In XGBoost, each new (possibly weak) classifiers aims to predict the errors of the previous classifier[30]。 XGBoost 背后的直觉是每个 新的分类器通常能够改进先前分类器的错误。. The intuition behind XGBoost is that each new classifier will generally be able to improve on the errors of the previous classifiers.

3 实施Implementation

在本节中，我们首先讨论我们在实验中使用的数据集。 然后我们详细介绍了我们的实验设置。In this section, we first discuss the dataset that we use in our experiments. Then we present a detailed view of our experimental setup.

3.1 数据集Dataset

恶意软件检测中概念漂移的研究需要一个数据集，其中的样本 可以放在相对时间线上。 我们使用 KronoDroid 数据集，该数据集被引入The study of concept drift in malware detection requires a dataset in which samples can be placed on a relative timeline. We use the KronoDroid dataset, which was introduced in[22];我们检索到了 数据集来自; we retrieved the dataset from[23].

KronoDroid 数据集包含 41,382 个 Android 恶意软件样本，属于 240 个不同的恶意软件系列。请注意，KronoDroid 数据集包含 真实样本和模拟样本——我们在本研究中仅使用真实样本。 数据集中的每个样本都包含 200 个静态特征 （权限、意图、硬件/软件要求等） 和 289 个动态功能（例如系统调用）。The KronoDroid dataset contains 41,382 Android malware samples belonging to 240 distinct malware families. Note that the KronoDroid dataset contains both real and emulated samples—we only use real samples in this research. Each sample in the dataset includes 200 static features (permissions, intents, hardware/software requirements, etc.) and 289 dynamic features (e.g., system calls).

根据介绍 KronoDroid 的论文According to the paper introducing KronoDroid[22], 每个样本包含四个不同的时间戳：最早修改、最后修改、 First Seen VT（病毒总量）和 First Seen ITW（野外）。 然而，在 Github 提供的数据集中, each sample contains four distinct timestamps: Earliest Modification, Last Modification, First Seen VT (on Virus Total) and First Seen ITW (in the wild). However, in the dataset available from Github[23], 恶意软件样本仅包含两个时间戳：, malware samples contain only two timestamps:最早修改日期EarliestModDate和and最高修改日期HighestModDate。 在本研究中，我们使用. In this research, we use the最高修改日期HighestModDate时间戳，因为它是最好的可用时间戳 无效样本数最少的数据集中的时间戳， 根据timestamp as it is the best available timestamp in the dataset with the least number of invalid samples, according to[22].

3.1.1 恶意软件家族Malware Families

尽管 KronoDroid 数据集中有 240 个恶意软件家族，但我们仍将注意力集中在 样本数量最多的五个恶意软件家族。 通过这样做，我们可以研究概念漂移并评估模型性能 在有意义的时间段内获取大量样本。 在这方面，我们的方法类似于Although there are 240 malware families in the KronoDroid dataset, we focus our attention on the five malware families with the largest number of samples. By doing so, we can study concept drift and evaluate model performance for a significant number of samples over meaningful periods of time. In this respect, our approach is analogous to that followed in[36].

正在考虑的五个恶意软件系列如下。The five malware families under consideration are the following.

气推/停止短信Airpush/StopSMS

是显示不需要的广告并且可能默默地显示的广告软件 收集并转发用户数据is adware that displays unwanted ads and may silently collect and forward user data[17]。随后，我们将这家人转介给 简单地作为. Subsequently, we refer this family simply as气推Airpush.

短信注册SMSReg

是否存在风险软件，例如可能包含假冒软件 “电池改善”应用程序is riskware that, for example, may include a fake “Battery Improve” application[18].

马拉普Malap

是从设备收集敏感信息的间谍软件is spyware that collects sensitive information from a device[22].

拳击手Boxer

是一个假装是合法安装程序但实际上发送 高费率 SMS 消息，用户不知情is a Trojan that pretends to be a legitimate installer but actually sends premium-rate SMS messages, unbeknownst to the user[19].

代理Agent

是一种下载并安装广告软件或恶意软件的木马 到受害设备上is a Trojan that downloads and installs adware or malware onto a victim device[20].

如上所述，我们数据集中的每个恶意软件样本都包含 489 个特征， 其中 200 个是静态的，289 个是动态的。然而，有些功能是 不是数字，而是文本。作为预处理步骤，我们删除所有 使用 Polars 库的非数字特征As mentioned above, each malware sample in our dataset includes 489 features, 200 of which are static and 289 of which are dynamic. However, some features are not numerical, but are instead text. As a preprocessing step, we remove all non-numerical features using the Polars library[40]。 预处理后每个特征向量的维度为 470。. The dimension of each feature vector after this preprocessing is 470.

此外，我们丢弃的样本Additionally, we discard samples whose最高修改日期HighestModDate时间戳 似乎是不正确的。具体而言，仅包含时间戳的样本 格式“timestamp seems to be incorrect. In concrete terms, only samples with a timestamp in the format “月/日/年MM/DD/YYYY”，并且 2000 年至 2025 年范围内的年份被视为有效。 表” and years in the range of 2000 to 2025 are considered valid. 3.2 实验设置Experiment Setup

如上所述，在本研究中，我们考虑了三种情况 评估采用概念漂移的好处 恶意软件域中的检测。我们将这三种场景称为静态训练， 定期再训练和漂移感知再训练。在每个场景中，我们分别训练四个 上面讨论的机器学习分类器 （MLP、SVM、RF 和 XGB）分别适用于 20 个不同的分类任务。As discussed above, in this research we consider three scenarios to evaluate the benefits of employing concept drift detection in the malware domain. We refer to these three scenarios as static training, periodic retraining, and drift-aware retraining. In each scenario, we train each of the four machine learning classifiers discussed above (MLP, SVM, RF, and XGB) on each of 20 distinct classification tasks.

直观上，我们预计定期再训练将产生最高的准确度，而静态训练将产生最高的准确度。 训练准确率将是最低的。如果我们能够准确地检测概念漂移 那么漂移感知再训练的准确度应该与周期性的相当 重新训练的准确性，同时减少重新训练模型所需的工作。Intuitively, we expect that periodic retraining will yield the highest accuracy while the static training accuracy will be the lowest. If we are able to accurately detect concept drift, then the drift-aware retraining accuracies should be comparable to the periodic retraining accuracies, while reducing the work required to retrain models.

3.2.7 效率Efficiency

在漂移感知场景中训练的模型是 在定期再训练场景中训练的模型。 这是因为检测到概念漂移的批次是一个子集 的所有批次中The models trained in the drift-aware scenario are a subset of the models trained in the periodic retraining scenario. This follows since the batches where concept drift is detected are a subset of all of the batches inFdF_{d}，并且在定期再训练场景中， 我们在每一批中重新训练一个模型, and in the periodic retraining scenario, we retrain a model at every batch ofFdF_{d}。 因此，漂移感知场景的效率衡量标准之一是 检测到概念漂移的批次 - 检测到的漂移点越多，模型就越多 必须对其进行培训，从而导致培训的总体成本更高。 从这个意义上说，定期再训练场景的效率可能是最差的， 静态场景具有最好的效率，因为至少需要训练一个模型。. Consequently, one measure of efficiency for the drift-aware scenario is the percentage of batches where concept drift is detected—the more drift points detected, the more models that must be trained, resulting in a higher overall cost for training. In this sense, the periodic retraining scenario has the worst possible efficiency, and the static scenario has the best possible efficiency, since at least one model must be trained.

3.3 超参数Hyperparameters

在展示我们的实验结果之前，我们需要考虑超参数。 在本节中，我们首先讨论学习模型的超参数调整， 影响每个模型的分类精度。 在讨论了我们的学习模型的超参数调整之后， 我们考虑漂移检测技术的超参数， 这会影响漂移感知场景下准确性和效率之间的权衡。Before presenting our experimental results, we need to consider hyperparameters. In this section, we first discuss hyperparameter tuning of the learning models, which affect the classification accuracy of each model. After discussing hyperparameter tuning for our learning models, we consider the hyperparameters for our drift detection techniques, which affect the tradeoff between accuracy and efficiency under the drift-aware scenario.

我们分类实验的一个重要步骤是执行超参数调整 以获得优化的学习模型。 我们使用OptunaAn important step in our classification experiments is to perform hyperparameter tuning to obtain optimized learning models. We use Optuna[38]，它执行 树结构 Parzen 估计器 (TPE), which performs a Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator (TPE)[56]寻找最好的 超参数。search for the best hyperparameters.

TPE是一种贝叶斯优化算法。 给定一个目标函数TPE is a Bayesian optimization algorithm. Given an objective functionfθf_{\theta}哪里whereθ\theta是一组参数， TPE 进行了多次试验is a set of parameters, TPE performs multiple trials overθ\theta，迭代地寻找最优值。 这种方法与网格搜索不同，因为 TPE 不会尝试每一个 空间中定义的值 - 它使用贝叶斯估计来找到更好的区域。 每个模型总共使用 100 次试验。, iteratively searching for optimal values. This approach is different from a grid search because TPE does not try every value defined in the space—it uses Bayesian estimates to find better regions. We use a total of 100 trials per model.

However, because of the small number of samples, such a validation set is not available. Tuning on the training set would also not be ideal because the reported metrics are computed on the test set, and overfitting is likely, especially given the limited sample size. Thus, the use of test-set tuning is intentional and can be interpreted as an oracle-style upper bound on performance rather than as a realistic deployment procedure. The goal of our experimental design is to initially establish the two baseline scenarios (static and periodic retraining), and then compare these two to various concept drift detection strategies under the drift-aware scenario. Under all three of these scenarios, the hyperparameter tuning is conducted in a similar fashion, and hence any change in accuracy in the drift-aware scenario should be attributable to the drift detection mechanism.

One technique for selecting the hyperparametersω\omega就是寻找帕累托有效的解决方案，也称为 帕累托前沿is to find Pareto efficient solutions, also known as a Pareto Front[7].

帕累托前沿广泛应用于工程和经济学，其中 必须在两个相互冲突的目标之间进行权衡Pareto Fronts are widely used in engineering and economics where tradeoffs have to be made between two conflicting objectives[13], 例如燃油效率和发动机功率之间的权衡。 通过使用帕累托前沿，可以找到一组点，其中 可以做出最佳权衡——在某种意义上，这一点将在下面明确说明。 帕累托前沿也称为非支配解集。, such as the tradeoff between fuel efficiency and engine power. By using a Pareto Front, it is possible to find a set of points where optimal tradeoffs can be made—in a sense that is made clear below. The Pareto Front is also referred to as the set of non-dominated solutions.

形式上，我们考虑一个紧凑的参数空间Formally, we consider a compact parameter spaceℝn\mathbb{R}^{n}和一个 客观空间and an objective spaceℝm\mathbb{R}^{m}具有映射功能with a mapping functionff这样such that

f:X→ℝmf:X\to\mathbb{R}^{m}

哪里whereX⊆ℝnX\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{n}。 然后，目标值可以表示为一组向量. Then, the objective values can be represented as a set of vectors

Y={y∈ℝm∣y=f(x),x∈X}.Y=\{\,y\in\mathbb{R}^{m}\mid y=f(x),\ x\in X\}.

让Let≻\succ是一个偏好运算符，它决定我们是否想要最大化或 最小化目标。一个向量be a preference operator that dictates whether we want to maximize or minimize the objective. A vectory′′∈ℝmy^{\prime\prime}\in\mathbb{R}^{m}据说严格支配 另一个向量is said to strictly dominate another vectory′∈ℝmy^{\prime}\in\mathbb{R}^{m} if

y′′≻y′.y^{\prime\prime}\succ y^{\prime}.

那么帕累托前沿可以表示为Then the Pareto Front can be expressed as

P(Y)={y′∈Y∣{y′′∈Y∣y′′≻y′,y′′≠y′}=∅}.P(Y)=\{\,y^{\prime}\in Y\mid\{\,y^{\prime\prime}\in Y\mid y^{\prime\prime}\succ y^{\prime},\ y^{\prime\prime}\neq y^{\prime}\,\}=\varnothing\}.

直观地讲，属于帕累托前沿的点创建了一个围绕 目标的所有其他要点。形成边界的点具有最好的可能 权衡，即在边界内移动会产生负面影响 至少在其中一个目标上。Intuitively, the points belonging to the Pareto Front create a boundary that surrounds all other points of the objective. Points forming the boundary have the best possible tradeoff, in the sense that moving inside the boundary produces a negative effect on at least one of the objectives.

4 实验结果与分析Experimental Results and Analysis

在本节中，我们将介绍上述概念漂移检测实验的结果。 这些实验的主要目标是确定每个漂移检测器的准确性和效率 （MK-Means、OCSVM 和 MMD），与静态和定期再训练场景相比。In this section, we present the results for the concept drift detection experiments discussed above. The primary goal of these experiments is to determine the accuracy and efficiency of each drift detector (MK-Means, OCSVM, and MMD), as compared to the static and periodic retraining scenarios.

4.1 静态和周期性结果Static and Periodic Results

回想一下，我们的静态和周期性实验独立于任何漂移检测 技术。在后续部分中，我们将考虑以下方面的准确性和效率： 基于所考虑的三个漂移检测器中的每一个的漂移感知场景。Recall that our static and periodic experiments are independent of any drift detection technique. In subsequent sections, we consider accuracy and efficiency in the drift-aware scenario based on each of the three drift detectors under consideration.

These results are provided for all four learning modelsLL以及所有 20 个家庭组合and all 20 family combinations for(Fd,Fc)(F_{d},F_{c}).

从数字来看From Figures14通过through17我们观察到 MLP、RF 和 MLP 都执行 好吧，XGB 滞后。我们通常还观察质量一致性 例如，在所有模型中，周期性场景都会大大提高准确性 对于（we observe that MLP, RF, and MLP all perform well, with XGB lagging. Furthermore, SVM achieves the highest accuracy in the static scenario for 40% of the family combinations (8 out of 20), followed by MLP and RF at 25% each, with XGB performing best in the remaining 10% of the combinations. If hyperparameter tunning was generally successful for learning modelLL, 我们期望其周期精度的分布更加 与静态精度的分布相比，结构紧凑并且具有更高的中值。 确实是这样的，如图, we expect the distribution of its periodic accuracies to be more compact and have a higher median, as compared to the distribution of the static accuracies. 总的来说，这些静态和周期性的结果证实了 我们的实验设计和超参数调整。 同样明显的是，有必要重新训练模型 反概念漂移。然而，考虑到训练学习模型的计算成本， 我们希望以更少的工作量获得与定期情景相当的结果。 为此，我们现在考虑对每个 章节中介绍的三个漂移检测器Overall, these static and periodic results confirm the success of our experimental design and hyperparameter tuning. It is also clear that retraining models is necessary to counter concept drift. However, given the computational expense of training learning models, we would like to achieve comparable results to the periodic scenario with less work. To this end, we now consider drift-aware retraining for each of the three drift detectors introduced in Section2.3。我们的首要目标是 确定我们是否可以获得与定期再训练相当的结果， 但就训练的模型数量而言，成本要低得多。. Our primary goal is to determine whether we can achieve results comparable to periodic retraining, but at a significantly lower cost, in terms of the number of models trained.

回想一下，我们根据以下次数来定义效率： 检测到概念漂移，这需要重新训练 的学习模型。 由于为所有三个漂移检测器训练相同的学习模型，因此所需的时间 训练任何个人学习模型与此衡量标准无关 效率。然而，训练我们三个人每人所需的时间 漂移检测技术差异很大，这是相关的 在这些技术之间进行选择时。Recall that we define efficiency in terms of the number of times that concept drift is detected, which necessitates the retraining of the learning models. Since the same learning models are trained for all three drift detectors, the time required to train any individual learning model has no bearing on this measure of efficiency. However, the time required to train each of our three drift detection techniques varies significantly, and this is relevant when selecting between these techniques.

平均时间比较A comparison of the average time per(Fd,Fc)(F_{d},F_{c})对即 三个漂移检测中的每一个都需要 技术以条形图的形式给出 图中pair that is required for each of the three drift-detection techniques is given in the form of a bar graph in Figure13。通过这种测量，OCSVM 需要的时间最少， 很大的差距，MK-Means 需要最多的时间，也有很大的差距。 造成这些巨大差异的主要原因是 OCSVM 仅当检测到概念漂移时才重新训练模型，而 每个块需要更新MK-Means和MMD， 无论是否检测到漂移。 还值得注意的是，OCSVM 的超参数数量最多 进行测试，如第 1 节中所述. By this measure, OCSVM requires the least time, by a wide margin, with MK-Means requiring the most time, also by a wide margin. The primary reason for these large discrepancies is that the OCSVM model is only retrained when concept drift is detected, whereas MK-Means and MMD need to be updated for each block, regardless of whether drift is detected. It is also worth noting that OCSVM has the largest number of hyperparameters to test and, as discussed in Section4.4, 这个数字可能会大大减少， 这将进一步增加其时间优势。, this number could likely be significantly reduced, which would further increase its timing advantage.

根据大多数考虑的指标，我们的 OCSVM 概念 漂移检测器优于 MK-Means 和 MMD 方法。 因此，我们得出结论，OCSVM 是最佳选择 本章分析的三种概念漂移检测技术之一。According to a majority of the metrics considered, our OCSVM concept drift detector outperforms the MK-Means and MMD approaches. Thus, we conclude that OCSVM is the optimal choice from among the three concept drift detection techniques analyzed in this chapter.

5 结论和未来的工作Conclusion and Future Work

在本章中，我们考虑了使用机器学习模型时的概念漂移检测问题 用于恶意软件分类。我们分析了三种不同的概念漂移检测方法， 其中两个使用机器学习技术，即Minibatch K-Means (MK-Means) 和一类支持向量机 (OCSVM)， 其中一个使用最大平均差异（MMD），一种统计分析技术。 我们比较了基于这三种技术的漂移感知检测策略，并在 在每种情况下，我们都将结果与静态场景进行比较（没有发生模型重新训练），并且 定期再训练（模型不断地再训练，无论概念是否 发生了漂移）。In this chapter, we considered the problem of concept drift detection when using machine learning models for malware classification. We analyzed three distinct concept drift detection approaches, two of which use machine learning techniques, namely, Minibatch K-Means (MK-Means) and One-Class Support Vector Machine (OCSVM), and one of which uses Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), a statistical analysis technique. We compared drift-aware detection strategies based on each of these three techniques, and in each case, we compared the results to a static scenario (no model retraining occurs), and to periodic retraining (models are constantly retrained, regardless of whether concept drift has occurred).

我们还对准确性和训练效率之间的权衡进行了广泛的调查， 使用帕累托前沿分析。此外，我们还分析了训练每个人所需的时间 概念漂移探测器。We also performed an extensive investigation of the tradeoff between accuracy and training efficiency, using Pareto Front analysis. In addition, we analyzed the time required to train each of the concept drift detectors.

我们基于 OCSVM 的概念漂移检测技术通常表现最佳， 关于准确性和训练时间，以及 就训练效率而言，OCSVM 与 MMD 相当。 在准确性、效率和训练时间方面， MK-均值通常是 三种漂移检测技术中效果最差的。 在测试的一组超参数上， 我们发现MMD是最一致的，但是最好的 超参数的选择，OCSVM 表现有些 比MMD还好Our OCSVM-based concept drift detection technique generally performed best, with respect to accuracy and training time, and with respect to training efficiency, OCSVM was equivalent to MMD. In terms of accuracy, efficiency, and training time, MK-Means was generally the least effective of the three drift detection techniques. Over the set of hyperparameters tested, we found that MMD was the most consistent, but for the best selections of hyperparameters, OCSVM performed somewhat better than MMD.

有趣的是，也许有些令人惊讶的是，机器学习 基于统计的方法（OCSVM）优于基于统计的方法（MMD）。 一种可能的解释是，虽然 MMD 对 基础统计数据发生变化，OCSVM 更擅长仅检测这些变化 从机器学习模型的角度来看，这可能实际上很重要。 这是一个值得进一步研究的话题。It is interesting—and perhaps somewhat surprising—that a machine learning based approach (OCSVM) outperformed a statistical based approach (MMD). One plausible explanation is that while MMD is more sensitive to changes in the underlying statistics, OCSVM is better at detecting only those changes that are likely to actually matter, from a machine learning model perspective. This is a topic that is worthy of further investigation.

未来研究的另一个途径是完善 用于概念漂移检测的窗口大小。虽然我们只考虑了固定窗口 尺寸为 50，首选最小的实际窗口尺寸， 因为我们希望在恶意软件进化后立即重新训练我们的模型。 另外，对MK-Means和OCSVM的参数进行了更深入的分析 可以更好地理解底层数据分布 从而提高这些漂移检测器的精度和效率。An additional avenue for future research is refining the window size used for concept drift detection. While we only considered a fixed window of size 50, the smallest practical window size would be preferred, since we want to retrain our models as soon as malware has evolved. Additionally, a deeper analysis of the parameters of MK-Means and OCSVM could yield a better understanding of the underlying data distribution and thereby improve the accuracy and efficiency of these drift detectors.

进一步探索的另一个有希望的主题是使用 长短期记忆 (LSTM) 模型作为漂移检测器。 LSTM 模型可以解释时间依赖性， 这可能使此类模型能够动态学习最佳窗口大小 作为培训过程的一部分。 最后，评估所提出的漂移检测技术的性能 实时恶意软件检测系统将提供有价值的见解 其实际适用性和可扩展性。Another promising topic for further exploration is the use of Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) models as drift detectors. LSTM models can account for temporal dependencies, which might enable such models to dynamically learn the optimal window size as part of the training process. Finally, evaluating the performance of proposed drift detection techniques in real-time malware detection systems would provide valuable insights into their practical applicability and scalability.
